verdict.rationale: Docusign is documented as a general agreement platform for sending, signing and storing any agreement, with reusable shared templates and data pulled from systems of record. That plausibly covers offer letters and confidentiality/IP agreements as standard signed documents. However, nothing in the evidence addresses hiring or equity paperwork specifically, or any option-grant handling. Missing for 10: explicit HR/offer-letter workflows, HRIS integrations, equity or option-grant support (e.g. cap-table or equity-management integration, grant tracking), and hands-on corroboration for these use cases.
